description: Pioneer is Fastino's hosted inference, fine-tuning, evaluation, and adaptive-routing platform for proprietary and open models. It exposes native, OpenAI-compatible, and Anthropic-compatible inference APIs.

availability.reason: Pioneer documents that users in countries subject to US sanctions and export restrictions, including these seven countries, cannot access models; upstream model-provider restrictions may further limit availability.

prompt_training_notes: Pioneer may use API inputs and outputs to improve and train platform models by default. Enterprise customers can opt out in Settings. Per-request store:false prevents payload persistence, but task-model adaptation is described separately from the platform-training opt-out.
regional_pricing_notes: The public live model catalog publishes USD input, output, cache-read, and cache-write rates per million tokens without regional variants.

sources.notes: Public OpenAI-compatible live catalog: exact callable route IDs, context/output limits, image-input support, lifecycle flags, and token/cache prices. Anthropic-compatible pioneer aliases are alternate routes to the same underlying models.
Live base-model catalog: task family, inference and training availability, ZDR eligibility, licensing, lifecycle/replacement metadata, limits, and pricing.
Authoritative native, OpenAI-compatible, and Anthropic-compatible endpoint behavior, streaming support, and store:false persistence controls.
Authoritative infrastructure, retention, training-use, zero-retention, and subprocessor disclosures.
Current Pro and Enterprise subscription pricing and included platform credits.
Legacy Hobby and Pro plan terms for accounts created before July 1, 2026.

verification.notes: Verified against Pioneer's public live catalogs and official documentation. Gateway routing remains deliberately disabled. Live /v1/models exposed 89 native IDs and 77 Anthropic-compatible aliases; /base-models exposed 27 base entities, of which 23 support inference and 7 support training.
